_comment: Scheduled opening hours for Fairfax early-voting sites, November general
elections 2020-2025. Source: Fairfax County Electoral Board records and
General Registrar's reports, supplied by someone who worked in the office.
Shape: each cycle has ordered `groups`. For a given (site, date) the LAST
matching group wins, where a group matches when its `sites` list contains
the site (or is "*") and the date falls within from..to inclusive. Within
the matched group, the block for that day of week supplies open/close.
Ordering is what expresses 'everyone does X, except the Government Center',
so keep the Government Center group last in each cycle.
A block absent for a day of week means no scheduled hours — which is
correct for Sundays before 2021, when the county offered no Sunday voting.
Whether a site was actually open on a date comes from the ballot data, not
from here: a site with no ballots recorded is never asked for hours. That
is why Great Falls in 2020 needs no special casing — it only ever recorded
Times are local, 24-hour, "HH:MM". Hours open are computed from them.

fairfax-2020-general.note: The Government Center ran 8:00-4:30 until the satellites opened on 14 October, then extended to 7:00 pm. Satellites opened at 11:00 am instead of 1:00 pm for the final Thursday and Friday because of heavy turnout. No Sunday voting this cycle.

groups.label: Satellite locations — extended for the final Thursday and Friday
Government Center — before the satellites opened
Government Center — extended hours from 14 October

fairfax-2021-general.note: The county's first cycle with Sunday voting, on 24 October. Thirteen further locations opened 21 October.

groups.label: All locations except the Government Center

fairfax-2022-general.note: Essentially the 2021 schedule repeated. Thirteen further locations opened 27 October; Sunday voting on 30 October.

groups.label: All locations except the Government Center

fairfax-2023-general.note: Thirteen further locations opened 26 October, after which all sixteen ran for ten consecutive days. Sunday voting on 29 October.

groups.label: All locations except the Government Center

fairfax-2024-general.note: A presidential cycle, so the thirteen further locations opened earlier than usual — 17 October — leaving all sixteen open for the final sixteen days. Sunday voting on 27 October.

groups.label: All locations except the Government Center

fairfax-2025-general.note: Thirteen further locations opened 23 October and ran for ten consecutive days. Sunday voting on 26 October.

groups.label: All locations except the Government Center
